_comment: "When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, gain 1{h}." Was on test_invented_refs.py's KNOWN_UNFIXED with the diagnosis 'when this is put into your graveyard from anywhere has no trigger': it was authored as ON_ENTER_PLAY gated on REF_EXISTS 'GRAVEYARD', a ref nothing sets, and a graveyard is not the arena -- so the trigger could never fire on either count. ON_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD is dispatched from Zone.add, which is the one place every graveyard route funnels through; that is what 'FROM ANYWHERE' requires, and it is the same choke-point argument the graveyard turn-marker beside it already makes. Hooking the discard, destroy and combat-chain-cleanup paths separately would have been three chances to miss one. The trigger fires on the card that entered, so no self-targeting condition is needed. player SELF on the gain because the clause says 'YOUR graveyard' and the card's controller is the one who gains.
